Upper West Region

Upper West

Long roads lead to towns and compounds designed around shade, gathering and the rhythms of daily life.

    Sudanese-style earth architecture in the regional capital.

    Wikipedia ↗

  • Wechiau Community Hippo Sanctuary

    A wall built to resist slave raiders.

    Known for its cathedral and its harvest festival.

Festivals in
Upper West.

Festivals and cultural events kept here, in calendar order. Many dates move from year to year, so each festival’s page has what we know about when.

  • Jan–Feb

    Paragbiele

    Tumu’s harvest thanksgiving, with farm produce on show, a durbar of chiefs, drumming and dance.

    Late January into FebruaryTumu

  • Sep–Oct

    Kobine

    Lawra’s harvest festival, famous for its dance competition to kuor drums and ankle bells.

    September or October, over four daysLawra
